verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting docs mention configuring a signal to be evaluated 'against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior,' implying some anomaly-detection alert type exists, but the evidence pack gives no detail on how this baseline/anomaly detection works, no naming of specific anomaly/outlier alert conditions, and no independent corroboration of its effectiveness. missing for 10: dedicated docs on NRQL baseline/anomaly alert conditions, configuration detail, and hands-on validation that it surfaces issues without manual thresholds.
